# Avatar
Atlas Avatar v1 — identity image, initials or person icon, with optional status dot and badge icon. 3 types × 5 sizes × 2 shapes (30 total).

When to use: represent a person or entity beside a name, in a list row, comment or group.
When not to use: as a button or link on its own (wrap it in a Button), for logos or product imagery, or to convey status without a text alternative.

Fallback order: valid image → initials → person icon. Alt text: an informative avatar (no adjacent name) gets meaningful alt text; a decorative avatar beside a visible name gets empty alt (alt=""); a failed image falls back to initials, then to the icon. Status dot uses the success token by default (swap the Status instance to change it) and is never colour-only — expose it as text to assistive tech. Shape=squircle uses the avatar-squircle-radius-* tokens. Avatar is presentational: no hover, active or disabled state.
